papers.title: Expanded repeat RNAs drive aberrant cortical network activity in benign adult familial myoclonus epilepsy.
papers.title_zh: 扩增重复RNA驱动良性成人家族性肌阵挛癫痫中的异常皮层网络活动。
papers.abstract: Expansions of short nucleotide repeats cause diverse neurological disorders, yet how they perturb neuronal function remains unclear. Benign adult familial myoclonus epilepsy (BAFME) is caused by intronic pentanucleotide repeat expansions in genes including SAMD12. Here, we establish patient-derived cortical organoids and a microelectrode array platform, coupled with a frequency-decomposition-based analytical framework, to characterize BAFME-associated neuronal hyperexcitability and compare organoid electrophysiological features with those observed in patient electroencephalographic recordings. Single-cell RNA sequencing reveals altered expression of genes related to calcium regulation and α-amino-3-hydroxy-5-methyl-4-isoxazolepropionic acid (AMPA) receptor function in BAFME cortical neurons. Consistent with these changes, BAFME organoids show an increased density of AMPA-receptor-positive synaptic puncta. Pharmacological AMPA receptor antagonism suppresses hyperexcitability. Antisense oligonucleotides targeting the expanded repeat RNA-which reduce pathogenic RNA foci without significantly affecting SAMD12 mRNA levels-also attenuate hyperexcitability. These findings indicate that targeting expanded repeat RNA mitigates aberrant cortical network activity in BAFME organoids.
papers.abstract_zh:
短核苷酸重复序列的扩增会导致多种神经系统疾病，但其如何扰乱神经元功能仍不清楚。良性成人家族性肌阵挛癫痫（BAFME）是由包括SAMD12在内的基因中内含子五核苷酸重复序列的扩增所致。在此，我们建立了患者源性皮质类器官和微电极阵列平台，并结合基于频率分解的分析框架，以表征BAFME相关……
神经元过度兴奋，并将类器官的电生理特征与患者脑电图记录中观察到的特征进行比较。单细胞RNA测序揭示了BAFME皮层神经元中与钙调节和α-氨基-3-羟基-5-甲基-4-异噁唑丙酸（AMPA）受体功能相关的基因表达发生改变。与这些变化一致，BAFME类器官显示AMPA受体阳性细胞的密度增加。
突触斑点。AMPA受体的药理学拮抗作用可抑制过度兴奋性。靶向扩增重复RNA的反义寡核苷酸（在不显著影响SAMD12 mRNA水平的情况下减少致病性RNA灶）也能减轻过度兴奋性。这些发现表明，靶向扩增重复序列RNA可减轻BAFME类器官中皮质网络的异常活动。

papers.title: Real-world antiseizure medication prescribing and treatment pathways in a pediatric health care system.
papers.title_zh: 儿科医疗保健系统中抗癫痫药物的真实世界处方和治疗途径。
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To characterize antiseizure medication (ASM) selection, subsequent ASM prescribing, and treatment pathways among patients with epilepsy receiving care within a pediatric health care system.
METHODS: We conducted a retrospective electronic health record study over 17 years. Each unique ASM was counted once per patient, and ASMs were ordered by the date of their first observed prescription. For each observed ASM, we determined whether a subsequent unique ASM was prescribed during available follow-up. Prescription of a third unique ASM was used as a proxy for potential drug-resistant epilepsy.
RESULTS: Among 20 009 patients, 27 ASMs and 3507 treatment pathways were identified. The most common first-observed ASMs were levetiracetam (35.1%), oxcarbazepine (17.2%), and valproic acid (12.3%). From 2010 to 2026, the proportion of first-observed prescriptions for levetiracetam increased from 23.1% to 41.5%. The proportion of all distinct ASMs first recorded for individual patients that were newer-generation ASMs increased from 0% in 2010 to 9.1% in 2026. The proportion of patients without a subsequent ASM ranged from 16.2% to 69.6% across commonly prescribed first-observed ASMs. Overall, 55.6% of patients had one unique ASM recorded, 22.4% had two, and 22.0% had at least three, thereby meeting the study's prescription-based proxy for potential drug-resistant epilepsy. Beyond the most common single- and two-ASM pathways, each remaining pathway accounted for less than 1% of the cohort.
SIGNIFICANCE: Prescribing remained concentrated among established ASMs, although their relative use changed substantially. The proportion of patients without a subsequent ASM varied widely across medications, and treatment pathways beyond first-observed therapy were highly heterogeneous. These findings characterize real-world treatment patterns and identify a need for comparative effectiveness studies of ASM sequencing.
PLAIN LANGUAGE SUMMARY: We examined antiseizure medication prescribing over 17 years among more than 20 000 patients with epilepsy receiving care in a pediatric health care system. More than half had only one medication recorded, whereas 22% had at least three medications; however, the available records could not determine whether these medications failed to control seizures. Levetiracetam became more commonly prescribed, newer medications remained a small proportion of overall use, and medication sequences varied widely after the first observed treatment. These findings highlight the need for better evidence to guide medication selection after initial treatment.
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：对在儿科医疗保健系统内接受治疗的癫痫患者的抗癫痫药物（ASM）选择、后续ASM处方和治疗途径进行描述。
方法：我们对17年的电子健康记录进行了回顾性研究。每种独特的抗癫痫药物（ASM）仅对每名患者计数一次，并按首次观察到的处方日期对ASM进行排序。对于每种观察到的抗癫痫药物，我们确定了是否
在可进行的随访期间，开具了后续的单一ASM。开具第三种独特ASM的处方被用作潜在耐药性癫痫的替代指标。
结果：在 20 009 名患者中，确定了 27 种 ASM 和 3507 条治疗路径。最常见的首次观察到的ASM是左乙拉西坦（35.1%）、奥卡西平（17.2%）和丙戊酸（12.3%）。从2010年至2026年，首次观察到的左乙拉西坦处方比例将增加
从 23.1% 上升至 41.5%。对于个体患者首次记录的所有不同ASM中，属于新一代ASM的比例从2010年的0%增加到2026年的9.1%。在常见处方中首次观察到的抗癫痫药物中，未接受后续抗癫痫药物治疗的患者比例介于 16.2% 至 69.6% 之间。总体而言，55.6% 的患者记录了一种独特的 ASM，22.4% 的患者记录了两种，22.0% 的患者记录了至少三种，从而满足了本研究基于处方的……
用于潜在的耐药性癫痫。除了最常见的单种和两种抗癫痫药物治疗方案外，其余每种治疗方案在队列中所占比例均不到 1%。
意义：处方仍集中在已确立的抗癫痫药物上，尽管其相对使用情况发生了显著变化。在不同药物中，未接受后续ASM治疗的患者比例差异很大，且首次观察到的治疗方案之外的治疗路径高度异质。
这些发现揭示了真实世界的治疗模式，并指出了对ASM用药顺序进行比较有效性研究的必要性。
浅显易懂的摘要：我们研究了在一个儿科医疗保健系统中接受治疗的20 000多名癫痫患者在17年间抗癫痫药物的处方情况。超过一半的患者仅记录了一种药物，而22%的患者至少记录了三种药物；然而，现有记录无法
确定这些药物是否未能控制癫痫发作。左乙拉西坦的处方使用更加普遍，新型药物在总体使用中仍占很小比例，并且在首次观察到的治疗后，药物使用顺序差异很大。这些发现凸显了需要有更好的证据来指导初始治疗后的药物选择。

papers.title: Etiology and geographic variation in acute symptomatic seizure management: An international vignette-based survey.
papers.title_zh: 急性症状性癫痫发作管理的病因和地域差异：一项基于案例的国际调查。
authors: International League Against Epilepsy Acute Symptomatic Seizure Task Force
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: Acute symptomatic seizures (ASyS) account for nearly half of new onset seizures, but evidence guiding management remains limited. We aimed to characterize international variation in ASyS management across common etiologies.
METHODS: We conducted a cross-sectional, vignette-based survey through the International League Against Epilepsy national chapters (February to May 2025). Five etiology-based vignettes assessed clinical and electrographic ASyS scenario after ischemic stroke, traumatic brain injury (TBI), meningitis, hyponatremia, and alcohol withdrawal. Respondents who managed neonatal seizures completed a neonatal stroke vignette. We assessed antiseizure medication (ASM) initiation, duration after clinical ASyS, and continuous electroencephalography (cEEG) use. Interrespondent variability was quantified by normalized Shannon entropy (H'). Multivariable generalized estimating equations accounted for repeated responses.
RESULTS: Among 963 respondents (92 countries), 62% recommended ASM initiation in clinical and 61% in electrographic ASyS scenarios. Overall ASM initiation variability was high (H' = .96), highest for alcohol withdrawal (H' = 1.0), followed by stroke (H' > .9), and consistently higher for electrographic than clinical ASyS. Etiology was the strongest driver of ASM initiation. Compared with stroke, ASM initiation odds were higher for TBI (odds ratio [OR] = 2.5, 95% confidence interval [CI] = 2.2-2.8) and meningitis (OR = 1.9, 95% CI = 1.7-2.2), and lower for hyponatremia (OR = .2, 95% CI = .2-.2) and alcohol withdrawal (OR = .5, 95% CI = .5-.6). Compared with Europe, initiation odds were higher in North America (OR = 2.7, 95% CI = 2.0-3.6), Asia-Oceania (OR = 2.4, 95% CI = 2.0-3.0), and Latin America (OR = 2.0, 95% CI = 1.5-2.7), but not Africa. These differences persisted after accounting for country income. Compared with stroke, the mean ASM duration was 3.2 months shorter for hyponatremia and .6 months longer for TBI. Alcohol withdrawal durations were polarized (41% discontinued at discharge; 20% continued >12 months). cEEG use was markedly higher in North America than Europe (OR = 11.3, 95% CI = 7.8-16.5). Among 291 neonatal respondents, 75% continued ASM beyond discharge.
SIGNIFICANCE: ASyS management varies markedly, reaching near-maximal heterogeneity in several common scenarios. Although etiology drives decisions, geography and provider characteristics also influence care, underscoring an urgent need for randomized trials and international consensus guidance to harmonize care.
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：急性症状性癫痫发作（ASyS）约占新发癫痫发作的近一半，但指导治疗的证据仍然有限。我们的目标是阐明不同常见病因下ASyS治疗的国际差异。
方法：我们通过国际抗癫痫联盟各国家分会（2025年2月至5月）开展了一项基于案例的横断面调查。五个基于病因的案例评估了临床和脑电图
缺血性卒中、创伤性脑损伤（TBI）、脑膜炎、低钠血症和酒精戒断后的疑似癫痫发作（ASyS）场景。处理过新生儿癫痫的受访者完成了新生儿卒中案例。我们评估了抗癫痫药物（ASM）的起始、临床ASyS后的持续时间以及持续脑电图（cEEG）的使用。受访者间的差异性通过归一化香农熵（H'）进行量化。多变量广义估计
ng方程考虑了重复的回答。
结果：在963名受访者（来自92个国家/地区）中，62%的受访者建议在临床ASyS情况下启用ASM，61%的受访者建议在脑电图ASyS情况下启用ASM。总体ASM起始变异性较高（H' = 0.96），酒精戒断时最高（H' = 1.0），其次是卒中（H' > 0.9），且脑电图ASyS始终高于临床ASyS。病因是启动ASM的最强驱动因素。与卒中相比，ASM
TBI（比值比 [OR] = 2.5，95% 置信区间 [CI] = 2.2-2.8）和脑膜炎（OR = 1.9，95% CI = 1.7-2.2）的起始几率较高，而低钠血症（OR = .2，95% CI = .2-.2）和酒精戒断（OR = .5，95% CI = .5-.6）的起始几率较低。与欧洲相比，北美（OR = 2.7，95% CI = 2.0-3.6）、亚洲-大洋洲（OR = 2.4，95% CI = 2.0-3.0）和拉丁美洲（OR = 2.0，95% CI = 1.5-2.7）的起始几率较高，但非洲的起始几率并不高。
。在考虑国家收入因素后，这些差异仍然存在。与卒中相比，低钠血症的平均ASM持续时间短3.2个月，TBI的平均ASM持续时间长0.6个月。酒精戒断的持续时间呈两极分化（41%在出院时停用；20%持续>12个月）。北美cEEG的使用率明显高于欧洲（OR = 11.3，95% CI = 7.8-16.5）。在291名新生儿受访者中，75%在出院后继续使用ASM。
意义
ANCE：ASyS的治疗方法差异显著，在几种常见情况下几乎达到了最大异质性。虽然病因是决策的驱动因素，但地理位置和医疗服务提供者的特征也会影响护理，这凸显了迫切需要开展随机对照试验和制定国际共识指南，以统一护理标准。

papers.title: Ketogenic diet therapy in adolescents and adults with epilepsy: A scoping review of cognitive outcomes.
papers.title_zh: 癫痫青少年和成年患者的生酮饮食疗法：对认知结局的范围综述。
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: The ketogenic diet treatment (KDT) is an established non-pharmacological treatment for drug-resistant epilepsy (DRE). However, rigorous research for seizure efficacy based on randomized controlled studies in adolescents and adults remains limited, and cognitive outcomes are rarely assessed using standardized measures.
METHODS: This scoping review has mapped evidence on cognitive outcomes of KDT in adolescents and adults with epilepsy. Following PRISMA-ScR guidelines, PubMed and Embase were searched for studies published between 1986 and 2026. Eligibility for this review required inclusion of adolescents or adults with epilepsy receiving KDT and reporting cognitive outcomes.
RESULTS: Of 951 records, 19 studies were included. Overall, KDT was associated with favorable seizure and cognitive outcomes, although reports of cognitive outcomes were generally subjective.
SIGNIFICANCE: Rigorous research designs were scarce, and evidence remains limited; future studies should use stronger designs, larger samples, standardized cognitive assessments, and longer follow-up periods.
PLAIN LANGUAGE SUMMARY: Research shows that people with epilepsy often experience difficulties with the brain's ability to process information. While dietary treatments have been shown to be effective for seizure control, less is known about their effects on cognition. We reviewed published research examining cognitive outcomes in adolescents and adults with epilepsy following dietary treatment. Most studies suggested that these diets had a positive effect on aspects of cognitive functioning. However, the available evidence remains limited. More studies with better designs using well-established cognitive assessments are needed to better understand these effects.
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：生酮饮食疗法（KDT）是一种公认的非药物性难治性癫痫（DRE）治疗方法。然而，基于青少年和成年人随机对照研究的癫痫发作疗效的严谨研究仍然有限，并且很少使用标准化指标来评估认知结局。
方法：本范围综述梳理了有关KDT对癫痫青少年和成年人认知结局的证据。
根据PRISMA-ScR指南，在PubMed和Embase中检索了1986年至2026年间发表的研究。纳入本综述的资格要求包括接受KDT并报告认知结局的癫痫青少年或成年人。
结果：在951项记录中，纳入了19项研究。总体而言，KDT与良好的癫痫发作和认知结局相关，但关于认知结局的报告通常具有主观性。
意义：
严谨的研究设计很少见，证据仍然有限；未来的研究应采用更严谨的设计、更大的样本量、标准化的认知评估和更长的随访期。
浅显易懂的摘要：研究表明，癫痫患者的大脑处理信息的能力通常存在困难。虽然饮食疗法已被证明对癫痫发作的控制有效，但对其影响的了解甚少。
对认知的影响。我们回顾了已发表的研究，这些研究考察了青少年和成年癫痫患者在接受饮食治疗后的认知结局。大多数研究表明，这些饮食对认知功能的各个方面有积极影响。然而，现有证据仍然有限。需要开展更多采用成熟认知评估方法、设计更完善的研究，以更好地了解这些影响。
papers.publication_label: 综述

papers.title: Scalp high-frequency oscillations differentiate neonates with hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy with and without electroencephalographically confirmed seizures.
papers.title_zh: 头皮高频振荡可区分患有缺氧缺血性脑病的新生儿，无论其是否经脑电图证实存在癫痫发作。
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: Hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) is a leading cause of neonatal seizures, but seizure detection is challenging when continuous electroencephalography (EEG) is unavailable and neonates undergo only a single routine EEG. Biomarkers derived from routine EEG may aid identification of neonates with seizures. We investigated whether scalp high-frequency oscillation (HFO) rates derived from the first eligible routine EEG (1) differentiate neonates with HIE with and without seizures; and (2) contribute to seizure classification alongside established clinical, neurophysiological, and imaging biomarkers.
METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed routine scalp EEG recordings from 33 term neonates with HIE (17 with seizures, 16 without), obtained at a mean postnatal age of 4 ± 3 days. The mean analyzed EEG duration was 38 ± 14 min in neonates with seizures and 36 ± 20 min in those without. HFO rates in sleep segments were quantified using a validated automated detector.
RESULTS: Scalp HFO rates were significantly higher in neonates with seizures than in those without (.12 ± .11 vs. .03 ± .02 HFOs/min/channel, adjusted p = .02). An HFO rate threshold of .07 HFOs/min/channel optimally discriminated neonates who had seizures from those who did not (area under the curve [AUC] = .81). HFO rates did not differ significantly according to HIE severity, therapeutic hypothermia, antiseizure medication response, EEG background activity, or magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) abnormalities. Multivariable models incorporating HFO rate, EEG background activity, and MRI findings showed discrimination (AUC = .92, 95% confidence interval [CI] = .69-1.00 for logistic regression; AUC = 1.00, 95% CI = .75-1.00 for random forest), with HFO rate as the strongest contributor to seizure classification.
SIGNIFICANCE: These findings support scalp HFO rate as a potential electrophysiological biomarker of seizure occurrence in neonatal HIE, complementary to EEG background assessment and MRI findings. Prospective studies are needed to determine whether HFOs can predict subsequent seizures.

目的：缺氧缺血性脑病（HIE）是新生儿癫痫发作的主要原因，但在无法进行持续脑电图（EEG）监测且新生儿仅接受一次常规脑电图检查时，癫痫发作的检测具有挑战性。常规脑电图得出的生物标志物可能有助于识别患有癫痫的新生儿。我们研究了从第一次符合条件的常规脑电图（1）中得出的头皮高频振荡（HFO）频率是否能够
有癫痫发作和无癫痫发作的HIE新生儿；以及（2）与已确立的临床、神经生理学和影像学生物标志物一起，有助于癫痫发作的分类。
方法：我们对33例HIE足月新生儿（17例有癫痫发作，16例无癫痫发作）的常规头皮脑电图记录进行了回顾性分析，这些记录是在出生后平均4 ± 3天时获得的。有癫痫发作的新生儿的平均EEG分析时长为38 ± 14 min，无癫痫发作的新生儿的平均EEG分析时长为36 ± 20 min。

的。
意义：这些发现支持头皮HFO率作为新生儿HIE中癫痫发作的潜在电生理生物标志物，是对脑电图背景评估和MRI结果的补充。需要进行前瞻性研究，以确定HFO是否可以预测随后的癫痫发作。

papers.title: Strengths and weaknesses in epilepsy training across residency programs in Italy: A multicenter survey by the Italian chapter of the Young Epilepsy Section (YES-I).
papers.title_zh: 意大利住院医师培训项目癫痫培训的优势和不足：意大利青年癫痫分会（YES-I）的多中心调查。
papers.journal: Epileptic disorders : international epilepsy journal with videotape
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: The objective of the study was to assess epilepsy-related services across Italian neurology and child neuropsychiatry residency programs, evaluate residents and early-career specialists' perceived strengths/weaknesses in epilepsy training, and identify unmet needs and expectations for improving residency programs and Young Epilepsy Section (YES)-Italy educational initiatives.
METHODS: A nationwide cross-sectional survey was conducted between January and April 2026 by a focus group of the YES-Italy Education Task Force. A structured questionnaire was distributed to neurology and child neuropsychiatry residents and specialists within 2 years of completing residency, assessing demographics, epilepsy-related services, self-perceived competencies, training strengths and limitations, and suggestions for improving residency curricula with YES-Italy educational activities. Descriptive statistics were used; group comparisons (neurology vs. child neuropsychiatry; residents vs. early-career specialists) employed the Mann-Whitney U test.
RESULTS: The survey was completed by 150 participants. Epilepsy training was widely available (85.3%) but variable and often brief (<6 months). EEG training was mostly embedded within epilepsy rotation (32.7%), organized as a distinct brief rotation (<3 months; 33.3%), or not available (19.3%). Core epilepsy services were widely present (inpatient wards 82.7%; neurophysiology laboratories 93.3%), while other services were less common (such as epilepsy surgery). Marked variability in Status Epilepticus management emerged across centers. Participants perceived adequate competence for core clinical-diagnostic domains, but lower competence for EEG interpretation and complementary disciplines. Perceived competence was higher in chronic than in acute care. Child neuropsychiatrists reported greater competence in neuropsychology and genetics, neurologists in neuroimaging and acute management. Clinical rotations and multidisciplinary case discussions were major strengths, whereas lectures and direct teaching required improvement. Suggestions for the YES-I group highlighted improving EEG training, structured educational initiatives, access to courses, webinars, and scientific materials.
SIGNIFICANCE: This survey highlights substantial heterogeneity and weaknesses in Italian epilepsy training, particularly regarding EEG interpretation, complementary diagnostics, and acute management, underscoring the need for national standardization, multidisciplinary educational pathways, and strengthened educational initiatives.
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：本研究的目的是评估意大利神经病学和儿童神经精神病学住院医师培训项目中的癫痫相关服务，评估住院医师和从业初期的专科医生对癫痫培训的感知优势/劣势，并确定改进住院医师培训项目和意大利青年癫痫科（YES）教育举措的未满足需求和期望。
方法：开展了一项全国性横断面调查。
由YES-意大利教育工作组的焦点小组于2026年1月至4月期间开展。向完成住院医师培训2年以内的神经病学和儿童神经精神病学住院医师和专科医生分发了一份结构化问卷，以评估人口统计学、癫痫相关服务、自我感知的能力、培训的优势和局限性，以及通过YES-意大利教育活动改进住院医师培训课程的建议。描述性

papers.title: Calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) in epilepsy: Mechanistic insights from preclinical models.
papers.title_zh: 癫痫中的降钙素基因相关肽（CGRP）：来自临床前模型的机制见解。
papers.abstract: Calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) is a pleiotropic neuropeptide widely expressed in the central and peripheral nervous systems, with established roles in neurovascular regulation, synaptic transmission, and neuroinflammation. While CGRP has been extensively characterized in migraine pathophysiology, its role in epilepsy remains incompletely defined and is primarily supported by experimental evidence. Preclinical studies consistently demonstrate CGRP upregulation following prolonged seizures, particularly in models of status epilepticus, and suggest that CGRP signaling may contribute to key processes implicated in epileptogenesis. These include modulation of neuronal excitability, blood-brain barrier permeability, and neuroimmune responses, such as microglial activation. At the same time, CGRP has been shown to engage neuroprotective pathways, including anti-apoptotic and anti-oxidative mechanisms, as well as barrier-stabilizing effects, supporting a complex and context-dependent role. Shared pathophysiological features between migraine and epilepsy, such as cortical hyperexcitability, neuroinflammation, and cortical spreading depolarization, provide a conceptual framework in which CGRP may act as a convergent mechanistic mediator. However, direct evidence in human epilepsy remains limited, and the translational relevance of these findings requires careful interpretation. This review provides a focused synthesis of mechanistic insights from experimental models, highlighting the dual role of CGRP in seizure-related processes and delineating current gaps in knowledge. Potential clinical implications, including the effects of CGRP-targeting therapies, are discussed in a hypothesis-generating context, with emphasis on the need for rigorous studies to clarify their relevance in epilepsy. PLAIN LANGUAGE SUMMARY: Migraine and epilepsy sometimes occur together and share changes in brain activity. This review examines CGRP, a signaling molecule involved in migraine, and its possible role in seizures. Animal studies suggest that CGRP can either increase abnormal brain activity and inflammation or protect nerve cells, depending on the conditions. Early observations in people raise the possibility that migraine medicines blocking CGRP could also affect seizures, but they do not prove a benefit. Further research is needed to determine whether these medicines can safely reduce seizures or prevent epilepsy.

papers.title: Subjective memory complaints and depressive mood in patients with epilepsy at the time of first seizure and one year later.
papers.title_zh: 癫痫患者在首次发作时和一年后的主观记忆障碍和抑郁情绪。
papers.abstract: Patients with epilepsy (PWE) often report subjective memory complaints (SMC) that reportedly do not thoroughly relate to 'objective' memory measures, but to depressive symptoms. While depressive symptoms appear to be involved very early in the disease, it is relatively unclear when SMC develop over the course of the illness. We examined two patient groups, namely PWE and patients, who had a first seizure (seizure patients, SP), but did not subsequently get the diagnosis epilepsy regarding factors influencing SMC scores at the time of the first seizure as well as one year later using regression analyses. These factors include a depressive symptom score, demographic and clinical variables. Additionally, we investigate the development of SMC and depressive symptoms over the time span of the first year after first seizure in both patient groups using analyses of variance (ANOVA). Regression analyses results revealed that depressive symptoms predicted subjective memory complaints at both time points. Group, based on diagnosed illness, did not predict an additional significant amount of variance. ANOVA results regarding SMC scores revealed that there were no systematic differences between patient groups and no significant development throughout the first year after first seizure. Results on depressive symptoms showed that PWE reported overall more depressive symptoms than SP. These findings hint towards the importance of monitoring depressive symptoms in epilepsy not only in patients who have had epilepsy for a long time, but also in newly diagnosed patients. Future studies are needed to investigate the beginning of SMC in epilepsy.

papers.title: From potential to practice: An International survey on technology adoption and needs in epilepsy neuropsychology.
papers.title_zh: 从潜力到实践：一项关于癫痫神经心理学技术采用和需求的国际调查。
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Technological integration offers opportunities to improve neuropsychological practice in epilepsy care. Compared to other healthcare fields, neuropsychology has been relatively slow to incorporate these advancements into clinical practice.
OBJECTIVES: To describe the use of technology in epilepsy neuropsychology and identify priorities for technological development.
METHODS: An online survey of multiple choice and open-ended questions was developed in English and translated into Spanish, then sent to practicing neuropsychologists working in epilepsy care across all six International League Against Epilepsy world regions. The survey collected data on the settings in which neuropsychological services are provided to people with epilepsy, the technologies currently in use, the barriers to technological adoption, and desired future developments.
RESULTS: 179 neuropsychologists from 39 countries participated in the survey. The majority of respondents were women (69 %), aged 30-49 (60 %), and held a PhD (60 %). Key barriers to technological adoption included concerns around tool validation, financial limitations to purchase existing tools, and a lack of culturally and linguistically relevant normative data. Priorities for future development included predictive algorithms, automating psychometric aspects of clinical practice, and better leveraging of functional neuroimaging technologies.
CONCLUSIONS: This international survey highlights that while epilepsy neuropsychologists are open to adopting new technologies in their clinical practice, there are several barriers hampering uptake across the field. Survey responses highlighted that technological developments that are practical, accessible, evidence-based, and suitable for culturally and linguistically diverse populations are required to meet the needs of the epilepsy neuropsychology workforce.

papers.title: Psychological interventions for functional/dissociative seizures: A systematic review.
papers.title_zh: 功能性/分离性癫痫发作的心理干预：一项系统综述。
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: Functional/dissociative seizures (FDS) have limited treatment options despite the major societal and personal impact of this condition. The efficacy of psychological interventions varies considerably and is influenced by social, economic, and personal factors. To guide future research on the condition, a systematic review of the published literature on the psychological treatments available for FDS was conducted. Current psychological interventions including diagnosis communication, psychoeducation, psychotherapy, hypnosis, and behavioural therapies have yet to show sufficient evidence of long-lasting successful treatment for FDS. The frequency and impact of FDS requires continued treatment development beyond the limited options currently available. Such treatments have been systematically reviewed for this purpose.
METHODS: A comprehensive literature search was carried out using the keywords: dissociative seizures, functional seizures, NEA, non-epileptic, pseudoseizures, psychogenic seizures, psychological treatment, hysterical seizures, and pseudoepileptic. Studies evaluating psychological treatments for FDS were included. Studies including patients with comorbid seizure disorders were also included.
RESULTS: A total of 55 studies (58 publications) met the inclusion criteria. A wide variety of psychological interventions for FDS have been investigated. Existing evidence suggests that several psychological interventions may be effective, with cognitive behavioural therapy demonstrating the strongest evidence base. Promising findings were also reported for diagnosis communication, psychoeducation, psychodynamic therapy, mindfulness-based therapy, behavioural therapy, and combined treatment approaches.
CONCLUSION: While a range of psychological treatments may be beneficial, cognitive behavioural therapy currently possesses the strongest evidence supporting its efficacy. However, no clear evidence suggests whether a particular intervention is most appropriate for specific patient subgroups. Structured diagnosis communication and psychoeducation appear to be valuable early interventions but may require additional psychological therapy to maintain treatment gains. Large studies of high methodological quality with longer follow-up periods are required to establish the most effective forms of treatment.

papers.title: Dopamine D2 receptor signaling alleviates seizure-related neuronal ferroptosis via MARCH8-mediated P2RX7 ubiquitination.
papers.title_zh: 多巴胺D2受体信号传导通过MARCH8介导的P2RX7泛素化减轻癫痫相关的神经元铁死亡。
papers.abstract: Epilepsy affects over 70 million people worldwide and remains a major cause of morbidity and premature death. Although dopaminergic signaling dysfunction has been implicated in this disorder, its protective mechanisms are not fully understood. Here, we demonstrated that dopamine D2 receptor (D2R) expression is downregulated during seizures and that D2R signaling protects against seizure. We identified the purinergic receptor P2RX7-a known mediator of neuronal injury - as a downstream target of D2R. Activation of D2R signaling alleviated P2RX7-dependent neuronal ferroptosis, an iron-dependent form of cell death, and attenuated seizure-related neuronal injury by promoting ubiquitination and degradation of P2RX7. Mechanistically, D2R signaling upregulated the E3 ubiquitin ligase MARCH8 in an AMPK-dependent manner. MARCH8 promoted K48-linked polyubiquitination of P2RX7, thereby targeting it for proteasomal degradation in neurons. The protective effect of D2R was attenuated in March8 knockout mice, supporting the involvement of MARCH8 in this pathway. Together, our findings identify a neuroprotective mechanism wherein D2R signaling promotes MARCH8-mediated ubiquitination and degradation of P2RX7, alleviating seizure-related neuronal ferroptosis. This work provides new insights into the pathogenesis of seizure-related neuronal injury and identifies potential therapeutic targets.

papers.title: From features to digital biomarkers: EEG-fNIRS classification pipelines for brain monitoring.
papers.title_zh: 从特征到数字生物标志物：用于脑监测的EEG-fNIRS分类流程。
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) and functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) are widely used for noninvasive brain monitoring in clinical and cognitive applications, where machine learning-based classification has become increasingly prevalent. Alongside algorithmic advances, a growing body of literature reports signal-derived metrics as digital biomarkers; however, their interpretation, validity, and comparability remain strongly dependent on target definition, processing pipelines, and evaluation practices. This review provides a structured overview of EEG- and fNIRS-based classification studies, with a particular focus on signal processing workflows and biomarker extraction. The reviewed literature is organized around key stages of the analytical pipeline, including target formulation, data preprocessing, feature extraction, and validation. Common feature families-spanning spectral, temporal, connectivity-based, network-level, and hemodynamic representations-are summarized and discussed in relation to their typical applications and limitations. The main contribution is an evidence-based distinction between signal features and credible candidate biomarkers. Reliability, analytical robustness, external generalization, and interpretability are considered within the intended context of use. Clinical utility is assessed separately from predictive performance. Across 117 primary studies, most measures remained candidate biomarkers; only four studies were assigned to independent clinical validation, with qualifications, and none evaluated clinical utility.

papers.title: Globus Pallidus Externus α-Band Activity Decreases After Deep Brain Stimulation in Clinically Responsive Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder Patients.
papers.title_zh: 在临床上对强迫症患者进行深部脑刺激后，苍白球外侧部的α波段活动降低。
papers.journal: Neuromodulation : journal of the International Neuromodulation Society
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Deep brain stimulation (DBS) of the anterior limb of the internal capsule (ALIC) is an effective treatment for severe obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). Identifying brain readouts of a positive response may guide further DBS optimization.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: We measured local field potential (LFP) changes from bilateral DBS leads in ten patients with OCD who were implanted at a uniform tractographic network target derived from prior DBS responders. We consistently stimulated dorsal lead contacts in the ALIC white matter while recording LFP from the ventral lead contacts in the grey matter of the anterior globus pallidus externus (GPe), a key node in the basal ganglia nonmotor indirect pathway.
RESULTS: After six months of DBS, OCD symptoms decreased by 40% on average across patients, along with a significant decrease in α-activity across both hemispheres. Only one patient did not have an improvement in symptoms, and this was also the only patient who never exhibited a decrease in α in either hemisphere.
CONCLUSIONS: Our findings suggest that therapeutic ALIC DBS coincides with a stable decrease in limbic-cognitive GPe α-power, which should be further investigated as a potential biomarker of sustained response.

papers.title: EEG-based Deep Learning Reveals Cortical Sensitivity to Small Changes in Deep Brain Stimulation Parameters.
papers.title_zh: 基于脑电图的深度学习揭示了大脑皮层对深部脑刺激参数微小变化的敏感性。
papers.abstract: Deep Brain Stimulation (DBS) is an invasive procedure used to alleviate motor symptoms in Parkinson's Disease (PD) patients. Despite its effectiveness, the impact of DBS on brain activity and the way to optimise stimulation parameters remains unclear. In this study, we aimed to map the sensitivity of cortical neural response to changes in DBS parameters in real-world clinical settings. We recorded in-clinic EEG data from PD patients during their clinical DBS programming sessions, both at rest and during arm movement. A siamese variant of the EEGNet deep learning architecture was trained independently for each patient and parameter combination to determine whether two 1-sec-long EEG segments were recorded under the same or different DBS parameters, yielding 30 independently trained models. Our models achieved an average accuracy of 74% in classifying whether two 1-second EEG segments corresponded to the same or different DBS parameters. Explainability methods were then applied to extract the neural oscillations learned by the models. Ablation studies identified mid-gamma oscillations (55-90Hz) as the key band for classifying these changes. Importantly, that was not driven by 1:2 gamma entrainment. In a sub-group of patients, the theta-alpha oscillations (4-12Hz) also contributed to detecting changes in DBS parameters. We demonstrate that small DBS parameter changes modify cortical activity in a consistent manner that can be detected using shallow convolutional networks on low-density EEG. Our findings suggest that cortical mid-gamma oscillations (55-90Hz) are highly sensitive to small changes in DBS settings. Our approach and findings could be leveraged towards identifying and defining novel digital biomarkers to guide DBS programming and adaptive DBS systems.

papers.title: Developmental Aspects of Language Mapping with Stereoelectroencephalography.
papers.title_zh: 立体脑电图语言定位的发育方面。
papers.journal: Journal of clinical neurophysiology : official publication of the American Electroencephalographic Society
papers.abstract: This review examines developmental perspectives on the use of stereoelectroencephalography (SEEG) for delineating language areas and networks in pediatric patients with drug-resistant epilepsy, both as a clinical tool for presurgical evaluation and as a modality for gaining neuroscientific insights into speech and language development. Language development is a dynamic process that begins before birth and continues into adulthood, shaped by the maturation of brain networks. SEEG allows high-resolution study of these networks, providing a unique perspective on the organization of language systems. This review traces language acquisition from early infancy through adolescence and adulthood, highlighting the pivotal role of neural oscillations. We then summarize classical and contemporary neural models of language organization, highlighting the distributed and hierarchical networks, and emphasize the high spatial and temporal resolution of SEEG for presurgical planning that enables clinicians to optimize neurosurgical interventions while preserving essential language areas and the tracts connecting them. Our review also addresses the human brain's remarkable plasticity and capacity for reorganization, which are especially pronounced in children and vital for adaptation to and recovery from neurologic injury or surgery. We focus specifically on developmental reorganization in pediatric patients with drug-resistant epilepsy and its implications for language mapping with SEEG. The review concludes with recommendations for designing language-mapping batteries tailored to the unique needs of pediatric patients.

papers.title: Medicare Claims-Identified Functional Neurosurgery Workforce in the United States: National Trends, Geographic Distribution, and Access.
papers.title_zh: 美国医疗保险索赔中确定的功能神经外科从业人员：全国趋势、地域分布和可及性。
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: The national distribution and geographic accessibility of the functional neurosurgery workforce remain poorly characterized. This study evaluated longitudinal trends in the claims-identified workforce and Medicare-billed service volume, geographic distribution, and county-level proximity to functional neurosurgical care in the United States.
METHODS: Medicare Physician and Other Practitioners data were analyzed from 2013 through 2024. Core functional neurosurgeons were identified as neurosurgery specialists with reportable Medicare fee-for-service (FFS) billing for selected deep brain stimulation, MR-guided focused ultrasound, responsive neurostimulation, Vagus nerve stimulation, or stereoelectroencephalography services. Annual provider and service counts were normalized to Original Medicare FFS beneficiary person-years. For 2024, straight-line distance from each county internal point to the nearest identified provider was calculated, weighted by county population, and evaluated by Social Vulnerability Index (SVI) and rurality.
RESULTS: Claims-identified providers increased from 142 in 2013 to 189 in 2024, while Medicare-billed services increased from 6,311 to 7,702. After FFS normalization, provider and service rates increased by 47.6% and 35.4%, respectively. Among 3,109 counties, the equal-county median distance was 72.9 miles (IQR, 43.3-113.7); 30.8% were more than 100 miles away and 7.1% were more than 200 miles away. The population-weighted median was 26.8 miles (IQR, 10.0-59.6), with 10.0% and 2.3% of the population residing in counties more than 100 and 200 miles away, respectively. After adjustment for rurality, SVI was not independently associated with continuous distance.
CONCLUSIONS: Medicare FFS-observable provider and billing activity increased between 2013 and 2024, while substantial county-level geographic disparities were observed in 2024. Workforce planning should consider geographic distribution, rural access, referral networks, and longitudinal multidisciplinary care.

papers.title: The mammalian regulatory architecture: biobehavioral portals and the organization of physiological state.
papers.title_zh: 哺乳动物的调节结构：生物行为门户和生理状态的组织。
papers.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Neuromodulatory interventions can produce overlapping adaptive outcomes despite engaging substantially different biological pathways. Pathway-centered approaches identify how interventions initially engage the nervous system and characterize pathway-specific mechanisms. Convergence across interventions raises an additional question: how can different biological routes influence overlapping domains of adaptive function?
METHODS: This conceptual paper develops the Mammalian Regulatory Architecture (MRA), an organizational framework informed by identified mammalian synapomorphies (shared derived characteristics) and comparative anatomical, developmental, physiological, and functional observations.
RESULTS: The MRA hypothesizes that mammalian evolution reorganized relationships among conserved regulatory processes through their integration with mammalian specializations and regulatory demands associated with nursing, prolonged developmental dependency, caregiving, co-regulation, and reciprocal social communication. The framework provides the basis for a biological portal model of neuromodulation that distinguishes the pathway of initial engagement from the functional significance of that engagement within the broader regulatory architecture. Whereas the pathway identifies how an intervention initially engages the nervous system, its portal significance concerns how that engagement influences state-regulating processes within the MRA.
DISCUSSION: The proposed framework reframes neuromodulation from a process defined primarily by its neural target or pathway to one in which pathway engagement may influence broader regulatory organization, physiological state, Accessibility-the state-dependent availability of existing adaptive capacities-and adaptive function. It offers an organizational account of how distinct biological routes may influence overlapping domains of adaptive function.

papers.title: Conductive Hydrogels for Invasive Neural Interfaces: From Materials Engineering to Neural Signal Interfacing and Neurorehabilitation.
papers.title_zh: 用于侵入式神经接口的导电水凝胶：从材料工程到神经信号接口和神经康复。
papers.abstract: In invasive neural interfaces, mechanical mismatch between traditional rigid electrodes and brain tissue often leads to inflammation and signal attenuation. Conductive hydrogels have emerged as ideal alternative materials due to their tissue-matching modulus, hybrid conductive networks, and wet adhesion properties. In this paper, we provide a narrative review of research progress on conductive hydrogels in invasive neural interfaces: we elucidate electronic, ionic, and hybrid conduction mechanisms; critically compare strategies for modulus matching and interfacial adhesion (such as catechol chemistry and covalent anchoring); and summarize their applications in neural signal recording, electrical/optical modulation, and rehabilitation for spinal cord injury and stroke. Finally, we discuss current challenges regarding long-term stability, wireless integration, and intelligent closed-loop systems and outline future directions involving AI-driven design combined with 3D biomanufacturing.

papers.title: Safety of responsive neurostimulation in pediatric and young adult patients with drug-resistant epilepsy: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
papers.title_zh: 对药物难治性癫痫的儿童和青年患者进行反应性神经刺激的安全性：系统综述和荟萃分析。
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: Responsive neurostimulation (RNS) is increasingly being used for pediatric drug-resistant epilepsy (DRE), but the safety of the procedure in children remains unclear. The authors systematically reviewed published clinical outcomes in pediatric RNS, with an emphasis on complications and other adverse events.
METHODS: The authors performed a PRISMA-guided systematic review and meta-analysis. PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library were searched from inception through August 12, 2025. They included observational studies reporting outcomes of RNS in patients aged ≤ 21 years at implantation and extractable pediatric data. Two authors independently screened articles and extracted data. The primary outcome was the proportion of patients experiencing at least 1 complication. A sensitivity analysis restricted to extractable patients aged ≤ 18 years was also performed.
RESULTS: Thirty-five studies met inclusion criteria, representing 358 pediatric patients who underwent RNS implantation. Most studies were case series (62.9%), followed by case reports (25.7%) and cohort studies (11.4%); all were conducted in the United States. The mean patient age at implantation was 14.8 years, and the mean follow-up was 20.3 months among studies reporting follow-up. Overall, 38 patients experienced at least 1 complication. The most frequently reported complications were infection (3.4%), transient neurological deficits (3.1%), return to the operating room (2.2%), and explantation (2.0%). Less common events included stimulation-related side effects (1.4%), CSF-related complications (1.1%), and wound dehiscence and device malfunction (0.6% each). Random-effects meta-analysis demonstrated a pooled overall complication proportion of 10.3% (95% CI 7.0%-14.9%; I2 = 0.0%). In the ≤ 18-year sensitivity analysis, 31 studies comprising 203 patients were included, with a pooled complication proportion of 8% (95% CI 4%-16%).
CONCLUSIONS: Published pediatric RNS experience suggests that complications are comparable to rates reported for similar procedures and are most often transient neurological symptoms, reoperation, or infection. However, the evidence base is largely limited to small observational reports with heterogeneous outcome definitions and high risk of bias. Higher-quality multicenter prospective studies with standardized reporting and longer follow-up are needed to better define safety and effectiveness of RNS in pediatric DRE. Systematic review registration no.: CRD420261339088 (https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/prospero/).

papers.title: Causal Evidence for Emotion-Selective Neural Populations Supporting Emotion Perception in the Human Third Visual Pathway.
papers.title_zh: 支持人类第三视觉通路中情绪感知的情绪选择性神经元群体的因果证据。
papers.journal: Annals of the New York Academy of Sciences
papers.abstract: The posterior superior temporal sulcus (pSTS) is central to social perception, but whether it contains emotion-selective neural populations that causally contribute to emotion recognition in humans remains unknown. Here, we used state-dependent cortico-cortical paired associative stimulation (ccPAS) to test whether emotion-selective populations within the human pSTS→V1/V2 re-entrant pathway can be selectively strengthened via Hebbian-like plasticity. Sixty participants received ccPAS targeting either backward (pSTS→V1/V2) or forward (V1/V2→pSTS) projections of the third visual pathway while viewing fearful or happy faces; only one emotion was temporally paired with stimulation. pSTS→V1/V2 ccPAS selectively improved recognition of the paired emotion, with no effects on the unpaired emotion or following V1/V2→pSTS stimulation. These findings provide causal evidence that spatially overlapping, but functionally distinct, emotion-selective neural populations within the human pSTS-V1/V2 pathway make specific contributions to emotion recognition, such that ccPAS strengthening of one population selectively improves recognition of its preferred emotion, highlighting the functional relevance and selective malleability of human pSTS-V1/V2 circuits for emotion recognition.

papers.title: Brain-computer interfaces for neurodegenerative diseases: A comprehensive review of closed-loop systems from diagnosis to neural rehabilitation.
papers.title_zh: 用于神经退行性疾病的脑机接口：从诊断到神经康复的闭环系统综合综述。
papers.abstract: Brain-computer interface (BCI) technology serves as an important bridge between the nervous system and external devices and has shown considerable promise for the diagnosis and treatment of neurodegenerative diseases, whose global burden continues to increase: in 2021, more than 57 million people were living with dementia worldwide, with Alzheimer's disease (AD) accounting for approximately 60-70% of cases, while an estimated 11.77 million people were living with Parkinson's disease (PD) in 2021, according to the Global Burden of Disease Study 2021. This growing disease burden, together with the progressive loss of cognitive, motor, and communicative functions, highlights the need for more precise approaches to early detection, functional assistance, and individualized intervention. Conventional diagnostic and therapeutic approaches remain poorly suited to early detection and timely intervention. This paper analyzes the development of BCI technology, from the first detection of electroencephalogram (EEG) signals to the parallel development of invasive and non-invasive systems, and outlines the basic principles of signal acquisition, processing, and decoding, together with the relative advantages and limitations of different approaches. It then focuses on the use of BCI in Alzheimer's disease (AD), Parkinson's disease (PD), and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), covering early diagnosis, functional reconstruction, and neuromodulation. The article also discusses the difficulties encountered by BCI technology in terms of technological realization, clinical translation, and ethical considerations, as well as several future research directions, including multimodal fusion, adaptive algorithms, closed-loop control systems, and personalized treatment so as to drive the applications of BCI in precision medicine and in neurological diseases.

papers.title: Optogenetics in neurobiology and neurodegenerative disorders: from neural circuit mechanisms to precision neuromodulation.
papers.title_zh: 神经生物学和神经退行性疾病中的光遗传学：从神经环路机制到精准神经调节。
papers.abstract: Neurodegenerative disorders, including Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, Huntington's disease, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, multiple sclerosis and stroke, are characterized by progressive neuronal dysfunction, synaptic impairment and neural circuit degeneration, leading to severe cognitive and motor deficits. Although considerable progress has been made in understanding their molecular pathology, the circuit level mechanisms driving disease onset and progression remain incompletely understood. Optogenetics, which combines microbial opsins, genetic engineering and optical stimulation, enables reversible, cell-specific control of neuronal activity with millisecond precision and has transformed neuroscience from observational analysis to causal investigation of neural circuits. This review summarizes recent advances in the molecular basis of optogenetics, microbial opsins, gene delivery strategies and optical stimulation technologies, together with their applications in basic neurobiology and neurodegenerative disease research. We discuss how optogenetics has advanced understanding of neural circuit organization, synaptic plasticity, memory, neurodevelopment, sleep regulation, protein aggregation, synaptic dysfunction, neuroinflammation, mitochondrial impairment, oxidative stress and regulated cell death. Although these studies have generated important mechanistic insights and demonstrated functional improvements in experimental models, translation into human therapies remains investigational due to challenges associated with gene delivery, long-term opsin expression, immune compatibility and optical accessibility. Emerging therapeutic strategies, including closed-loop neuromodulation, wireless photostimulation, artificial intelligence-assisted neural decoding, nanotechnology enabled light delivery and brain computer interfaces, are critically evaluated with emphasis on their current evidence status, translational challenges and limitations for clinical implementation. Collectively, optogenetics provides an unprecedented platform for deciphering disease mechanisms and evaluating circuit-based neuromodulation strategies, while continued technological and biological validation will determine its future role in precision therapies for neurodegenerative disorders.
